constraints: Must be called only after WEB SERVICE CALL.
returnValue should be a process variable (e.g. $result, matching the proxy method's return); array/variable declarations must use the Compiler/Arrays theme commands beforehand.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: Web Services (Client) SOAP call sequence: WEB SERVICE AUTHENTICATE (optional) and/or WEB SERVICE SET OPTION (optional) configure per-call client state -> WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER is called once per request parameter to build the SOAP message -> WEB SERVICE CALL sends the request (consuming the authenticate/option/parameter state and erasing any previous result) -> WEB SERVICE GET RESULT retrieves each returned value (pass '*' on the final call to free memory) -> on error, WEB SERVICE Get info can be called from an ON ERR CALL method to inspect the SOAP fault.

overloadMerges.note: Autoparse defaulted returnValue to direction 'in', but the parameterTable arrow (←) shows it is filled in by the command (out), not supplied by the caller.

params.name: returnValue
params.description: Filled with the value sent back by the Web Service

params.name: returnName
params.description: Name of the specific returned parameter to retrieve (usually unnecessary since most Web Services return a single value)
If passed, frees the memory devoted to processing the request; must be passed only after retrieving the last value returned by the Web Service

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves, in returnValue, the value (or the specific named parameter returnName) sent back by the last-called Web Service.
